name: desk-park
description: 闲亭 DeskPark — 简洁优雅的网页桌游平台：扑克、麻将与更多桌面游戏，支持单人与多人联机，可扩展自定义玩法。

scripts.build: npm run build -w @park/web && npm run build -w @park/server
scripts.test:legacy: node scripts/test-legacy-bootstrap.mjs && node scripts/test-legacy-design.mjs && node scripts/test-legacy.mjs
scripts.test:tractor: node scripts/test-tractor-online.mjs && node scripts/test-tractor-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-tractor-multiplayer.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p packages/engine/test --noEmit && tsc -p packages/protocol --noEmit && tsc -p packages/protocol/test --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/legacy --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/legacy-tractor --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
